name: decomposition-reframe-reconciliation
body:
RECONCILIATION — the decomposition reframe [with user]. Source: two user decisions handed to the spec-writer.

Decision 1 (reframe the goal): the goal is NOT to get files under a line count; it is that apg's source is well-decomposed, DRY, modular and maintainable. Line count is a signal, not a target. Applied: `requirements.requirement.bounded-module-size` → `requirements.requirement.decomposed-source-modules` (feature `module-size` → `source-decomposition`); `global.constraint.module-size-budget` → `global.constraint.decomposition-quality`; `domain.value.module-size-budget` → `domain.value.module-size-signal` (the ~400-line figure is now explicitly indicative, never a target). `requirements.constraint.module-size-scope` was updated in place (body + `attaches-to`) rather than renamed. The DRY dimension is now first-class in both the requirement and the global law.

Decision 2 (scope): the law applies repo-wide over first-party source, excluding vendored code (`src/cpplib/vendor/**`) and testdata (`testdata/**`) — the root Rust crate (`src/*.rs` + `build.rs`) and the eight frontend crates. The spine was extended: `domain.group.source-layout` and `domain.entity.source-module` are now `realised-by` each of the eight frontend containers, and each of those containers is `implemented-by` its crate's code root.

Narrowing: the old requirement's `drives` to `domain.entity.source-file` was DROPPED. `source-file` is prior change-set work (`realised-by` `solution.component.identity-layer`, whose `implemented-by` code this change-set does not target); keeping the drive would make the verify gate demand tasks over untouched prior code, the same failure recorded in `requirements.note.every-tracked-file-graphed-spine-narrowing`. `source-file` remains driven by `portable-graph-identity` and `repo-relative-file-identity`.

Anchors verified in the branch graph: the eight frontend code roots are `rust.structfrontend`, `rust.pyfrontend`, `rust.apg-rustfrontend`, `cpp.cpplib`, `java.(default)`, `go.apg/gofrontend`, `csharp.Apg.CsharpFrontend`, `ts.apg-tsfrontend`. Caveats: `cpp.cpplib` is the module node for `src/cpplib/main.cpp` and its vendored tree-sitter headers alike (the law's scope excludes `src/cpplib/vendor/**` at the file level); `java.(default)` is the Java frontend's default-package module (the subject of `requirements.requirement.java-default-package-identity`).

Left to the plan-writer (not solved here): `Cargo.toml`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `scripts/gate.sh` and `rust-toolchain.toml` have no `File` node in the installed binary's graph; and adding `src/lib.rs` alongside `src/main.rs` risks a `rust.apg` lib/bin FQN collision. See `solution.note.library-surface-non-graph-artifacts`.
